mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of triggered instances during periods of FEDFUNDS decline, or the 20d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a t-test against a baseline of FEDFUNDS stability.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market weakness, triggering market pessimism and negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing above 4.0%, or the 5d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) against a baseline of stable unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) above historical thresholds signals robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both proxies meet thresholds, or returns are negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained upward momentum in the INDPRO index during a supply shock recovery phase indicates improving production capacity, fostering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO shows sustained upward momentum for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) during the supply shock recovery phase, or returns are negative despite INDPRO's upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment (PAYEMS below 5 million) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when PAYEMS <5 million, or returns are negative despite lower unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 305 suggests accelerating inflation, prompting market concerns and negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 305, or returns are positive despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP demand (GDPC1 >21,000) and rising retail sales (RSAFS >700,000) simultaneously indicate robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both proxies meet thresholds, or returns are negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: During a cyclical supply trough with constraints, INDPRO reaching a 12-month low while showing no upward momentum triggers negative S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO reaches a 12-month low while showing no upward momentum
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) during the cyclical trough, or returns are positive despite the signal.
